schema.description: In-org request of customer-returns (ADR 0017, ADR 0018). orderId names the outbound order whose ship-to is the return's pickup address. The return destination is named by EXACTLY ONE of destinationNodeId (the returns node; this context derives the label's destination prefix from its own node view) and the deprecated destinationPostalPrefix (a prefix the caller supplies). Both, or neither, is validation-failed.

oneOf.title: Destination named by a caller-supplied prefix (deprecated)

destinationNodeId.description: The node the return goes to (node-topology's nodeId, any node type). The label's destination prefix is derived by this context from the node's registered postal code: its first 5 characters from A-Z 0-9 after upper-casing, the whole run when shorter (ADR 0002 A10, ADR 0018). Not to be sent together with destinationPostalPrefix.

destinationPostalPrefix.description: Deprecated (ADR 0018): the return destination's prefix as the caller knows it, taken as sent. Send destinationNodeId instead; this property is removed in a later, separately coordinated change once no caller sends it. Not to be sent together with destinationNodeId.
